label: Thought episodes, assent and intellectual exercise
summary:
4957af60-055f-5398-892c-96bfbe0b9eb1 (Variant): 80bb76d9 uses assent for every occurring episode. The borne willing control in Round3CogitoBase removes that classification. A cogito whose occurrence predicate includes willing or doubting cannot use the universal premise; the narrow assent branch remains available on witnessed assent. Retain the narrower occurrence reading.

4bc1befb-0788-5c26-9aef-2e57b15950ef (Variant): cecc4365 uses universal classification of occurring episodes as intellective. A broad cogitatio that includes sensation does not supply the classification. Descartes, Principles I §9, is a lead for the broad inventory; this variant keeps the narrower judgment or understanding domain. Retain the intellective-only variant.

84c57a8c-d9a2-5672-8b7f-200117f13497 (Bridge): cecc4365 also attributes an intellective episode to any bearer as that bearer's exercise. The gap is from bearing or hosting an event to exercising it. Strong prima facie warrant is available for a performative first-person bearer interpretation; an observation record or extrinsic episode assignment would not secure it. Check the bearer role on the exact first-person witness and derive the attribution only if bearing encodes subject ownership.

8d90c06f-1a21-5765-a7d4-5c1d927694e9 (Primitive): 80bb76d9 needs the bearer of an assenting episode to opine its content. Prima facie conceptual warrant comes from understanding assent as the bearer's taking that very content to be true. Defeaters are an independently specified split between propositional acceptance and Opines, or a bearer relation that only represents a host. Retain as a candidate conceptual premise under the subject-ownership reading.
blocker: The occurrence predicate, bearer relation, and force of the episode must jointly pick out the same first-person performance before the two classification routes can carry it.
